says: Alice has answered the WAL-or-rollback conflict with WAL and keep-until-change, and the application is recorded against both participants at their exact record revisions. A choice about an unrelated concern (how long operation receipts are kept) is then published to the repository memory, moving that source's head; her next use of the journal concern is still admitted on the kept application without a question. Then a third applicable alternative (WAL with synchronous NORMAL) is published to her personal memory: her next use is blocked with preference_invalidated, and the use after it waits on a new question over all three participants at basis generation 2. She answers WAL again with keep-until-change and the new application is recorded over the three. Then the unchosen rollback choice is corrected by a lifecycle event: the next use is again blocked with preference_invalidated, because a change to an unchosen participant moves the basis as much as a change to the chosen one. What must not happen: an unrelated record forcing a question, or a new or changed alternative being missed because only the chosen record was checked.
